table item {
  id i64 identity
  code varchar(16)
  owner_id i64 null
  qty i32
  rev i64
  tag varchar(16) null
  meta text null
  deleted_at datetime(6) null
  primary key (id)
  unique uq_item_code (code)
  unique uq_item_tag (tag)
  index ix_item_owner (owner_id)
  foreign key fk_item_owner (owner_id) references owner (id) on delete restrict on update restrict
  check ck_item_qty (qty >= 0)
  settings {
    soft_delete deleted_at
    codec meta json
  }
}

table owner {
  id i64 identity
  name varchar(32)
  primary key (id)
}

table ghost {
  id i64 identity
  primary key (id)
}
